description: Machine-readable registry of human gate signatures. An agent may only create or update an entry with status PENDING_HUMAN_SIGNATURE and null signature/date. Verification is fail-closed: object/packet must exist and their SHA-256 must recompute, otherwise the entry is invalid.

hash_policy.normalisation: LF: CRLF replaced by LF before hashing (project convention, cf. tools/run_pit_prereg_evaluation.py)

rules.on_object_missing: fail closed: the entry is invalid and must not be treated as signed
rules.on_sha_mismatch: fail closed: the entry is invalid; recompute the pin from a reviewed copy
rules.on_edit_after_pin: any edit of object or packet changes its SHA: re-pin under a new version, otherwise tests/test_signoff_registry.py fails by design
rules.signature_location: docs/185 is a pinned template: the human signs a separate copy (paper/PDF/scan) and records signature/date/decision in this entry; do not edit the pinned files to add a signature
